briefing.text: Information Technology still leads News buzz at 81.2 (flat vs the day before, down 4.8 over the week) with NVDA, MSFT, AVGO, AMD and AAPL, but its mentions fell 17%. Materials gained most on News (buzz +1.1, mentions -19%, sentiment 0.05; FCX, NEM), while Real Estate (buzz -6.2, mentions -52%) and Utilities (-6.2, mentions -39%, sentiment -0.07) fell most. On X, Energy mentions jumped 345% (buzz 86.4, +2.4; BP, XOM, CVX) and Information Technology stays on top at 92.3 with mentions up 29% (NVDA, MU, AMD); Communication Services slipped from rank 2 to 5 (NBIS, GOOGL, META). On Reddit, Information Technology leads at 93.5 (buzz -0.7, mentions -42%, sentiment -0.01; NVDA, ORCL, AAPL), Materials is up 1.3 (SCCO, CCJ) and Utilities (-3.2) and Industrials (-2.6) lost the most.

ADI #1: only fund-stake notices and an earnings-volatility watch list; it has earnings 11-24, which fits the rank better than the news.
CC #2: two shareholder class-action reminders (sentiment -1.0); the lawsuit news matches the high X attention but is negative.
PM #3: fund-stake notices and a mention in a stock-list article; nothing here explains the jump from rank 43.
DKS #4: a Coupang comparison and a market-bottom piece; earnings 11-24 is the likelier driver.
ZM #5: 14 articles on its earnings today and options traders expecting a big move; this explains the ranking.
SGHC #6: analyst fair-value cut and a sector list; mild news, X attention is doing the work.
DLTR #8: a fund-stake cut and a market piece; earnings 11-24 is the main reason.
DG #9: a fund-stake rise and an unrelated Meta item; the news does not explain the rank.
BBY #11: 12 articles previewing tomorrow's Q3 earnings; this explains the ranking.

ADI ranks first mainly on volume (0.75 vs normal, 96th percentile) and X attention (0.86 vs normal, 90th percentile), with earnings on 11-24 as the catalyst and a 2.1-sigma price move (-8.3% in 24h). CC jumped from rank 54 to 2 on X attention 2.33 vs normal (99th percentile) and Reddit/overall attention 0.88, plus a 2.6-sigma drop, though its volume is only average. PM rose from rank 43 to 3 on X attention 1.11 and attention 0.73 vs normal with solid volume (0.60), and has no earnings catalyst, only Kalshi Zyn markets. In all three, attention on X and overall attention carry the most weight (35% each), so the rankings follow social buzz more than price.

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
